sloka: एष मह्यम् वरम् दत्त्वा पुरा मामभिपूज्य च ।स पश्चात्तप्यते राजा यथान्यः प्राकृतस्तथा ॥२-१८-२२॥
transliteration: eṣa mahyam varam dattvā purā māmabhipūjya ca ।sa paścāttapyate rājā yathānyaḥ prākṛtastathā ॥2-18-22॥

translations.english: In the past the king had honoured me with (two) boons. Now like any other common man he is repenting (for the same).
